purpose: Freeze the V162 evidence boundary, successor hypotheses, validation plan, and one-shot CPU rules before any V162 implementation code exists. V162 is an architectural response to frozen aggregate V160/V161 evidence, not a same-song threshold retune.

allowedEvidenceBeforeV162Implementation.useRestriction: Only the aggregate values copied into this preregistration and reference-blind source/QC structure may shape V162. No V161 event rows or professional-reference event/measure details may be inspected for tuning.

V162 therefore treats fixed-gap consolidation as over-destructive and must restore genuine repeated/rearticulated attacks without returning to V160 broad harmonic event flooding.
frozenFailureInterpretation.guitarTimingSubdivision: V161 Guitar measure+pitch F1 remains far above gross timing F1, and gross remains far above primary timing F1. Local onset refinement alone did not solve event-to-grid placement. V162 will retain reference-blind beat/measure evidence but replace simple nearest-time 16-step placement with a song-blind subdivision-lattice evidence model.
frozenFailureInterpretation.guitarRegister: V161 performed 382 isolated register repairs. V162 preregisters continuity-aware octave/register reasoning so an octave change must be supported by local spectral evidence plus neighboring pitch-track continuity rather than one-event evidence alone.
frozenFailureInterpretation.bassDirection: Bass improved modestly across primary, gross, and measure+pitch metrics with similar event count, so V162 retains the useful onset/harmonic/pYIN foundation but replaces the zero-activation pitch-transition recovery branch with stable pitch-state/rearticulation segmentation.
frozenFailureInterpretation.notPermittedConclusion: No event-level claim about the professional reference is permitted. These hypotheses derive only from frozen aggregate scores and reference-blind runtime aggregates.

V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H1_guitarRearticulationSegmentation: Replace fixed same-MIDI gap merging with onset-aware note-state segmentation. Overlapping/sustained Basic Pitch fragments may consolidate, but a same-pitch fragment separated by a supported new attack must remain a distinct note. Numeric attack/continuity rules must be sealed before implementation.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H2_guitarEvidenceRecoveryWithoutFlooding: Standalone harmonic-track event emission remains forbidden. Missing Guitar attacks may be recovered only when an independent instrument onset intersects a persistent Basic Pitch/model pitch state and harmonic/fundamental evidence supports the same pitch. Recovery must be attack-specific and deterministically capped.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H3_continuityAwareRegisterInference: Octave/register selection becomes a short local track-state decision using raw pitch, harmonic/fundamental evidence, and neighboring admitted pitch continuity. Isolated +/-12 repair from a single frame is replaced by deterministic sequence-aware reasoning.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H4_songBlindSubdivisionLattice: Keep the validated beat/measure backbone, but within each beat construct four 16th-step positions from local reference-blind onset evidence (drums/mix plus instrument onset) and regularized beat boundaries. Event quantization chooses among nearby subdivision states using evidence and temporal proximity rather than only globally interpolated nearest-step rounding.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H5_instrumentSpecificGridEvidence: Guitar and Bass may use instrument-specific onset evidence to choose among the same shared subdivision lattice while preserving one canonical measure/step coordinate system. No scorer tolerance or reference alignment may change.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H6_bassStablePitchStateSegmentation: Replace the inactive one-threshold pYIN transition proposal branch with a frame-state segmentation architecture: robustly smoothed pYIN/CQT consensus creates stable pitch states; new notes arise from stable state changes or supported same-pitch rearticulation onsets; sustained states do not emit repeated duplicates.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H7_activityAndConfidenceAsAdmissionNotDe: Activity/confidence gates remain song-blind admission evidence. V162 may not target the professional reference event count or tune event density from the score; event count is an outcome of the sealed state/attack model.
V162ArchitectureHypotheses.H8_noMicroTune: V162 must implement the new segmentation/register/subdivision architecture. It may not merely alter V161's 80ms merge, onset window, or admission thresholds in response to the V161 score.
